title: ControlPlaneState
description: Schema for runtime STATE.json in the external Google Drive control plane.

state_version.description: Monotonically increasing version number for optimistic concurrency.

execution_id.description: Unique UUID/timestamp identifying this specific run.

task_id.description: Immutable identifier for the current task.

parent_task_id.description: Identifier of parent task if this is a corrective retry.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of CURRENT_TASK.md ensuring payload-first consistency.

expected_git_head.description: Required starting Git commit SHA before execution.

resulting_git_head.description: Resulting Git commit SHA pushed to remote.
